svg.title: Extending the generic client engine
svg.desc: Four variants plug into the same engine. Hexa Quest illustrates the domain and presentation extension points and the two registrations that connect a fifth variant.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p:
Generic engine · GameEngine and Board
Variants supply cell, move and state types
and rules through IGameRules

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p:
Domain · layer 1
Cell, move, state and IGameRules implementation
BaseGameRules or SourcedGameRules
IVariantFactory creates a session and progress model

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Presentation · layer 3
VariantPresentationFactory supplies
ICellRenderer and IInputMapper

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p:
Composition root · layer 4
VariantFactoryRegistry + VariantPresentationRegistry
Register both factories under the same gameId

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p:
Additional domain extension points
IScoringPolicy · IPieceSource · IProgressModel
LevelSpec and ILevelValidator for level-based variants
IUndoable for variants with undo
